cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Access Has a Price
cards.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll permit an introduction to the curator once you've hung my exhibition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hang it Saturday. Can you send her portfolio requirements now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Approved, with frame collection added to your Saturday. Then I'll send the requirements.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. May I have her email instead, so I can ask her directly?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may, if you take the show down on Sunday too. Direct access is a larger privilege than having me pass along a list.
